integrity: Source results and prior special-case theorems credited. Analytical argument plus finite linear-program checks; no experimental enumeration presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one split halfspace, genuinely two-sided integral block capacities; arbitrary multiple-split matroids excluded. An independent priority determination has not been made.
title: Three-barrier Euclidean inballs and dual cubical incenter strata of elementary split matroid polytopes
